description: This file contains implementations of various RNN cell functions such as LSTM, GRU, and vanilla RNN cells, along with a specialized 'milstm_cell' function. It provides multiple variations of RNN cells used in deep learning models.

methods.name: milstm_cell(x, hx, cx, w_ih, w_hh, alpha, beta_i, beta_h, bias)
methods.description: Implements a specialized multi-input LSTM cell with additional parameters for alpha, beta_i, and beta_h, following a specific research approach.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor] lstm_cell( input: Tensor, hidden: tuple[Tensor, Tensor], w_ih: Tensor, w_hh: Tensor, b_ih: Tensor, b_hh: Tensor, )
methods.description: Standard LSTM cell implementation with input, hidden states, weights, and biases.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor] flat_lstm_cell( input: Tensor, hx: Tensor, cx: Tensor, w_ih: Tensor, w_hh: Tensor, b_ih: Tensor, b_hh: Tensor, )
methods.description: Simplified LSTM cell that takes combined inputs for gates and produces hidden and cell states.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor] premul_lstm_cell( igates: Tensor, hidden: tuple[Tensor, Tensor], w_hh: Tensor, b_ih: Tensor, b_hh: Tensor, )
methods.description: LSTM cell variant that pre-adds input gate activations before passing to standard gates.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor] premul_lstm_cell_no_bias( igates: Tensor, hidden: tuple[Tensor, Tensor], w_hh: Tensor, b_hh: Tensor )
methods.description: Similar to premul_lstm_cell but without bias term, for efficiency or specific use cases.

methods.name: gru_cell(input, hidden, w_ih, w_hh, b_ih, b_hh)
methods.description: GRU cell implementation based on input and hidden states with reset and update gates.

methods.name: rnn_relu_cell(input, hidden, w_ih, w_hh, b_ih, b_hh)
methods.description: Simple RNN cell applying ReLU non-linearity.

methods.name: rnn_tanh_cell(input, hidden, w_ih, w_hh, b_ih, b_hh)
methods.description: Simple RNN cell applying Tanh non-linearity.
